critical_items.note: Issuer, intermediary and offering identified in Form C and XML.
SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity), Series 2026.
Form of SAFE (Exhibit B) is readable in doc 6 pp.55-66; it is an unsigned form with blank investor fields. Exhibit E image pages (111-127, 132-150) are blank in the text layer.
$1.00 price (arbitrary), $15,000,000 pre-money cap; cap denominator excludes SAFEs and notes.
Minimum $100; issuer-paid intermediary fees stated; investor-paid fee not stated in the pack.
Reviewed (not audited) statements for years ended 2025-12-31 and 2024-12-31; report dated 2026-07-23. No 2026 statements.
Deadline 2026-12-18 stated, but no platform page or closing evidence in the pack; a future deadline is not proof of availability.

missing_information: Investor-paid fees (if any) are not stated in the Form C or SAFE.
Platform availability/live status of the Republic offering and any closings are not evidenced.
No financial statements after 2025-12-31; basis of the $654,000 June 30, 2026 cash figure (cash vs marketable securities) and the average monthly net loss behind the 5-month runway are not provided.
No stated amount, timing or cost of the next milestone (e.g. Wakefern/Wegmans launches, vertical integration); use of proceeds does not tie to a specific milestone.
Terms of the existing 2022 SAFEs (discount, MFN, other terms) are not in the pack beyond the $15,000,000 cap; no breakdown of holders.
No options, reserved equity plan pool or warrants disclosed; adequacy of 3,000,000 authorized shares for conversion is unknown.
Wayflyer loan details are inconsistent (maturity and payment terms); loan agreements not provided.
Traction claims (1800 doors, run rate, Amazon growth, named retailers) have no supporting data, dates or customer contracts.
Customer concentration, retailer contracts and gross margin trajectory are not disclosed (cost of goods sold exceeded revenue in FY2025 and FY2024).
Exhibit E testing-the-waters image pages are blank in the text layer; their content is not readable.
Whether the CEO-as-Lead can amend SAFE provisions without investor consent, and the Lead's conflict-management, is not detailed beyond the cited text.
No independent corroboration (third-party) of any business, team or regulatory statement.
